description:
Descend into the cursed halls of Count Dracula’s castle in Dracula: The Disciple, a first-person puzzle adventure where occult knowledge is your only path to immortality.

Play as Emile Valombres, a dying French archivist drawn to Dracula’s abandoned stronghold in search of a cure. Explore a Gothic castle filled with mystical puzzles, forbidden experiments, alchemical secrets and dark rituals left behind by the Count himself.

Master occult tools, grow supernatural ingredients, perform ancient rites and uncover the truth behind vampiric transformation. But salvation comes at a terrible price… To cheat death, you must become something else.

🩸 Solve intricate supernatural puzzles
⚗️ Practice alchemy and occult experimentation
🦇 Embrace vampiric powers to unlock new paths
🏰 Explore Dracula’s haunting castle and uncover its secrets

Will you escape death… or become the next master of the castle?

Wishlist Dracula: The Disciple now on PlayStation 5 and follow for more dark revelations!

You’re not watching the nightmare. You’re inside it.

Evil Inside VR is not just a simple adaptation to Virtual Reality. It’s a complete reimagining of the original story, rebuilt to deliver a new, deeper, and more terrifying psychological horror experience.

After the death of his mother and the arrest of his father, Mark tries to contact her through a Ouija board. But something goes wrong… and his descent into the unknown begins.

description:
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014780

Make out. Sneak out. Hang out.

On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of memories, set to the soundtrack of a generation.

En route to their final party together, a perfectly curated playlist draws three friends into dreamlike reenactments of their formative memories. Experience a variety of narrative vignettes exploring the pivotal moments that shaped them. Players will immerse themselves in the teenage wasteland by playing through a mixtape of joyful gameplay, from skateboarding and flying to taking photos after hours at an abandoned theme park, hitting baseballs, and putting on a fireworks show from the backseat of a car. It's the greatest hits of the teenage experience, from the first kiss to the last dance.

Featuring music from DEVO, Roxy Music, Lush, The Smashing Pumpkins, Iggy Pop, Siouxsie and the Banshees, Joy Division, the Cure and many more.
